preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 300 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of cycles k must be between 1 and n^2 inclusive, or -1 if no solution exists.
Each cycle must have a length of 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:int(stdout.split()[0])+1] for v in line.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the cycles must be between 1 and n inclusive.
Each cycle must have distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(tuple(sorted(pair)) for pair in zip(line.split()[1:], line.split()[1:]+line.split()[1:1]))) == len(line.split())-1 for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:int(stdout.split()[0])+1])
postconditions.description: Each cycle must have no repeated edges.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for line in stdout.split('\n')[1:int(stdout.split()[0])+1] if tuple(sorted(pair)) in zip(line.split()[1:], line.split()[1:]+line.split()[1:1])) == 2 for pair in zip(edges, edges[1:]+edges[:1]))
postconditions.description: Each edge must appear in exactly two cycles.
